normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Walking distance to the beach- Conveniently located near Seaside and Seagrove Beach- 4 adult bikes- Garage- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Experience days of blissful relaxation at 34 Seagrove Village Drive. Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach and within walking distance to Seaside, this 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home accommodates up to 10 guests. With multiple porches and beach access only a short 4-minute walk away, guests will find plenty to love!Cheerful orange and white checkerboard tiles greet guests in the main-floor entryway of this 2-level home. Turn left to find the kitchen, sunlit from an overhead skylight and equipped with everything guests need to cook delicious homemade creations. There’s plenty of seating for meals or board games with a dining table featuring 2 chairs and 2 benches, a 4-seat round table, a small cafe set for 2, and a 3-stool breakfast bar. Around the corner is a bright and inviting living space, where guests can sink into the soft sofa and comfortable armchairs for a relaxing night watching TV. Through a pair of French doors is the screened-in porch where guests can bask in the balmy weather on the cushioned porch swing and soft patio furniture. A picnic table on the side patio encourages guests to enjoy an alfresco lunch or drinks in the coastal air. When night falls, retire to the primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. There’s also a bunk room with a twin-over-twin bed and a twin-over-full bed.On the second floor, discover 2 guest bedrooms with access to a shared porch furnished with wicker chairs and a side table. The first guest bedroom has a queen bed, while the second has a queen bed and twin-over-twin bunk bed.Enjoy a delightful Seagrove Beach vacation at 34 Seagrove Village Drive. Convenient on-site parking and 4 complimentary adult bikes provide easy access to the nearby towns and Timpoochee Trail! To reach Scenic 395 Beach Access, head west on Seagrove Village Drive, turn left onto South County Highway 395, then left on East County Highway 30A. Beach access is on the right. Book this charming home for a getaway today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: (SLEEPS 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Guest Bedroom: 1 Twin-over-Twin and 1 Twin-over-Full Bunk Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed and 1 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Loft Area: Twin Daybed with Twin Trundle Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWe are happy to welcome 1 dog for an additional non-refundable pet fee of $400, plus tax.

body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seagrove Beach 34 Seagrove Village Dr Santa Rosa Beach, FL Bedrooms 4 Beds 9 Sleeps 10 Full Baths 4 Half Baths 0 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Walking distance to the beach - Conveniently located near Seaside and Seagrove Beach - 4 adult bikes - Garage - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Experience days of blissful relaxation at 34 Seagrove Village Drive. Located in the heart of Seagrove Beach and within walking distance to Seaside, this 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home accommodates up to 10 guests. With multiple porches and beach access only a short 4-minute walk away, guests will find plenty to love! Cheerful orange and white checkerboard tiles greet guests in the main-floor entryway of this 2-level home. Turn left to find the kitchen, sunlit from an overhead skylight and equipped with everything guests need to cook delicious homemade creations. There’s plenty of seating for meals or board games with a dining table featuring 2 chairs and 2 benches, a 4-seat round table, a small cafe set for 2, and a 3-stool breakfast bar. Around the corner is a bright and inviting living space, where guests can sink into the soft sofa and comfortable armchairs for a relaxing night watching TV. Through a pair of French doors is the screened-in porch where guests can bask in the balmy weather on the cushioned porch swing and soft patio furniture. A picnic table on the side patio encourages guests to enjoy an alfresco lunch or drinks in the coastal air. When night falls, retire to the primary bedroom with a king bed and private bathroom. There’s also a bunk room with a twin-over-twin bed and a twin-over-full bed. On the second floor, discover 2 guest bedrooms with access to a shared porch furnished with wicker chairs and a side table. The first guest bedroom has a queen bed, while the second has a queen bed and twin-over-twin bunk bed. Enjoy a delightful Seagrove Beach vacation at 34 Seagrove Village Drive. Convenient on-site parking and 4 complimentary adult bikes provide easy access to the nearby towns and Timpoochee Trail! To reach Scenic 395 Beach Access, head west on Seagrove Village Drive, turn left onto South County Highway 395, then left on East County Highway 30A. Beach access is on the right. Book this charming home for a getaway today!
